title: als-nhird-reproducibility: code and data for the ALS NHIRD proposal-planning and decision-support platform study
description: Curated reproducibility package for the study of a simulation-assisted proposal-planning and decision-support platform for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis research in the Taiwan National Health Insurance Research Database. Contains the analysis code (differential expression, ODE/PINN digital twin, power/cost planning, proposal-generation evaluation), the platform rule engines, the archived result records (benchmarks, transcriptomic tables, 1,000-patient simulation, 60-run generation record, simulated human-factors profiles), and the offline verification harness. No manuscript text is included. Zenodo deposition is pending; no DOI is assigned yet.
